verdict_text:
YES

The keep index for `[6144, ...]` tensors with block 768 skips h=5, yielding rows 0..3839 then 4608..6143 in order (clauses 1 and 2); for `attention.dense.weight` it selects along dim 1 with block 256, keeping columns 0..1279 then 1536..2047 (clause 3). Only the three head-bearing tensors per layer for layers 0..15 are touched, names are preserved, and all 244 tensors are written to a single `out/T2/model.safetensors` (clauses 4 and 5). `index_select` preserves the float16 dtype, so values are bit-exact. All four required checks are asserted before `save_file`. One caveat outside the artifact: it depends on an unshown `_ckpt.load_checkpoint`, so correctness of dtype and key-set preservation on load rests on that helper.
